messages.text:
"Create a realistic 3D open-world action adventure game inspired by GTA.

GAME TITLE: NUSANTARA CITY

Create a large and immersive 3D open-world city inspired by modern Indonesian cities.

MAIN FEATURES:

1. Third-person playable human character.
2. Realistic walking, running, jumping and movement animations.
3. Large open-world city with skyscrapers, houses, roads, shops, gas stations and beaches.
4. Drivable cars, motorcycles, sports cars and trucks.
5. Realistic vehicle physics and driving controls.
6. Pedestrians and AI traffic throughout the city.
7. Police chase system with 5 wanted levels.
8. Missions, jobs and rewards.
9. Money system to buy cars, houses and clothes.
10. Day and night cycle with realistic lighting and weather.
11. Interactive buildings and shops.
12. Beautiful realistic 3D graphics and detailed environments.

MOBILE CONTROLS:

- Virtual joystick on the left.
- Camera control on the right.
- Jump and sprint buttons.
- Enter and exit vehicle buttons.
- Gas and brake buttons.
- Mobile-friendly interface.

GRAPHICS:

- Realistic 3D models.
- High-quality textures.
- Realistic shadows and lighting.
- Smooth animations.
- Detailed environments.
- Optimized for Android phones.

IMPORTANT:
Make this a fully playable 3D game, not a static scene or concept image. Implement actual player movement, driving, interaction, missions and gameplay mechanics. Make all mobile controls functional.
"
